stories.title: Huracán Isaías alcanza categoría 2; autoridades evacúan zonas costeras en Florida

en.title: Hurricane Isaías reaches category 2; authorities evacuate coastal zones in Florida
en.summary: Hurricane Isaías strengthened to category 2 status, prompting evacuation orders for coastal areas in Florida.

stories.title: Anne Carson, poeta de la tradición de Safo, gana el Nobel de Literatura

en.title: Anne Carson, poet in the tradition of Sappho, wins the Nobel Prize in Literature
en.summary: Anne Carson, a poet working in the classical tradition of Sappho, has been awarded the Nobel Prize in Literature.

stories.title: Simon es huracán de categoría 1; causa inundaciones en Acapulco

en.title: Simon is a category 1 hurricane; causes flooding in Acapulco
en.summary: Hurricane Simon, which intensified from a tropical storm, caused severe flooding in various areas of Acapulco due to heavy rainfall.

stories.title: Protestan en NY contra ICE por disparo de agente a inmigrante dominicano

en.title: Protesters in NY against ICE over agent shooting of Dominican immigrant
en.summary: An ICE agent shot a Dominican national during an arrest in New York, with protesters criticizing the incident as part of the government's immigration enforcement efforts.

stories.title: Descarta presidente de EU bombardear Irán antes de las elecciones

en.title: U.S. President Rules Out Bombing Iran Before Elections
en.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump stated he will not bomb Iran before the November 3 midterm elections and indicated his government is having productive conversations with Iran.

stories.title: Riña en penal de Sinaloa deja 9 reos y un menor muertos

en.title: Prison Fight in Sinaloa Leaves 9 Inmates and One Child Dead
en.summary: A riot at El Castillo penitentiary in Mazatlán, Sinaloa resulted in nine inmate deaths and one visiting two-year-old child killed, along with 16 other inmates injured.

stories.title: El Nobel de Literatura 2026 para Anne Carson, poeta del silencio

en.title: Anne Carson, Poet of Silence, Wins 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature
en.summary: The Swedish Academy awarded the Nobel Prize in Literature to poet Anne Carson for her ability to engage with classical Greek literature while creating innovative forms for contemporary writing.

stories.title: Trump descarta ataques contra Irán antes de comicios

en.title: Trump Rules Out Attacks Against Iran Before Elections
en.summary: President Donald Trump ruled out attacking Iran before the November 3 U.S. legislative elections and stated Washington maintains productive conversations with Tehran.

stories.title: Huracán Simon alcanza categoría 1; emiten alerta por lluvias torrenciales

en.title: Hurricane Simon reaches category 1; alert issued for torrential rains
en.summary: Hurricane Simon intensified to category 1 on the Saffir-Simpson scale off Mexico's Pacific coast, bringing heavy rainfall to Guerrero and Michoacán.

en.title: Hurricane 'Simon' intensifies to Category 1
en.summary: Hurricane Simon strengthened to Category 1 status with maximum sustained winds of 120 km/h, located 380 km south of Manzanillo.

stories.title: Dispara agente del ICE contra un dominicano en NY

en.title: ICE agent shoots Dominican man in NY
en.summary: An ICE agent shot and wounded a Dominican man who was with a 5-year-old child in Marble Hill, New York.

stories.title: Gana Anne Carson el Nobel de Literatura

en.title: Anne Carson wins Nobel Prize in Literature
en.summary: Anne Carson received the Nobel Prize in Literature for her work that engages with classical themes while creating new forms for contemporary literature.

stories.title: Nissan se suma a otras 9 marcas tradicionales que importan autos desde China para abastecer a México

en.title: Nissan joins 9 other traditional automakers importing cars from China to supply Mexico
en.summary: Nissan launched its first model developed and manufactured in China for global export, the Frontier PRO PHEV, joining other major manufacturers already importing thousands of vehicles from China to Mexico.

stories.title: AriZona cambia de cancha: de su famoso té a bebidas con 5% de alcohol para conquistar otro mercado

en.title: AriZona shifts focus: from its famous tea to alcoholic beverages with 5% alcohol to conquer another market
en.summary: AriZona is expanding beyond its traditional tea products to include beverages made with tequila, while maintaining the fruity flavors associated with the brand.

stories.title: De Dr. Simi a Bienestar: las marcas que ahora tienen cafetería aunque su negocio original sea otro

en.title: From Dr. Simi to Bienestar: brands that now have cafes despite their original business being different
en.summary: Several non-coffee brands are diversifying into cafe operations, with some opening permanent locations and others using temporary cafes for product promotion and market access.

stories.title: Cobrar una incapacidad del IMSS ya no será igual para todos: este monto cambia la forma de pago

en.title: Collecting IMSS disability benefits will no longer be the same for everyone: this amount changes the payment method
en.summary: Mexico's social security system has implemented a new payment scheme for disability benefits that requires bank accounts in certain cases, though the benefit amounts remain unchanged.

stories.title: Los contratos mixtos no atraen a los gigantes petroleros, pero algunas empresas sí ven negocio con Pemex

en.title: Mixed contracts do not attract major oil companies, but some firms do see business opportunity with Pemex
en.summary: While large petroleum companies avoid mixed contracts with Mexico's state oil company, smaller firms like Consorcio 5M del Golfo are securing fields under this arrangement, though they express concerns about its suitability for all projects.
